tagline: 美能达便携相机，1989 年发布
description: 美能达于1989年推出的便携相机。配备1:4/65mm, switchable to 1:7/60mm。感光度Crippled DX decoding — either ISO 100 or 400.。Active infrared autofocus from 75 cm to infinity.。

specs.对焦: Active infrared autofocus from 75 cm to infinity.
specs.感光度: Crippled DX decoding — either ISO 100 or 400.
specs.取景器: Magnification changes when lens is switched.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, automatically activated in low light or with close-ups.
specs.英文简介: The Minolta AF-Tele 60 was an easy-to-use all-automatic compact cameras for 35mm film introduced by Minolta circa 1989.
